entities.name: Garth One-Eye
entities.description: A wizard and rare survivor of the Fifth House who arrives in Estark seeking revenge on the Grand Master.

entities.name: Hammen
entities.description: Old leader of a brotherhood of pickpockets, secretly of the Fifth House and once Garth's father's servant.

entities.name: Zarel
entities.description: Grand Master of the Arena who uses the games to keep the populace and Houses in check; killed by Garth.

entities.name: Kuthuman
entities.description: The former Grand Master who killed the Fifth House and became a Planeswalker; he kills tournament winners and is defeated by Garth and Norreen.

entities.name: Norreen
entities.description: Benalish warrior who aids Garth and later becomes his partner.

entities.name: Varena
entities.description: Fighter who earns Garth's respect; he is forced to kill her, she is revived, and she becomes Grand Master.

entities.name: Naru
entities.description: Giant, dim-witted fighter who helps rescue Varena.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: Brutal city that loves bloody battles in the Arena.

entities.name: Four Houses
entities.description: The four surviving houses of fighter wizards.

entities.name: Fifth House
entities.description: House destroyed a generation ago by the former Grand Master; Garth and Hammen are survivors.

entities.name: Festival of the Arena
entities.description: Annual tournament in the Arena that became ever bloodier.

entities.name: Greensleeves Trilogy
entities.description: Trilogy connected to the novel's story.

events.summary: Garth arrives in Estark, is befriended by Hammen, and becomes known as One-Eye after winning a magical duel.
events.quote: Garth quickly becomes known as One-Eye after winning a magical duel on a public street.

events.summary: The former Grand Master killed the entire Fifth House and took their mana, becoming Planeswalker Kuthuman.
events.quote: the former Grand Master killed off the entire Fifth House and took their cache of mana, becoming Planeswalker Kuthuman

events.summary: Garth saves the Benalish warrior Norreen from a backstab and confronts her foe's House with her.
events.quote: Garth prevents her from being stabbed in the back by her opponent's friend

events.summary: Garth stirs discord and rioting by joining and abandoning each of the Houses.
events.quote: He stirs up discord and rioting in the already dangerous and unstable city.

events.summary: Zarel captures and tortures Garth; Hammen, Norreen and Varena free him.
events.quote: Garth is captured and tortured by Grand Master Zarel

events.summary: Garth fights in the Arena under the Fifth House's colors, revealed as a survivor who lost his eye when his family was killed; Norreen leads a mob into the Arena to aid him.
events.quote: Norreen leads the crowd as a mob into the Arena to aid him.

events.summary: Garth is forced to kill Varena with a Psionic Blast when the final battles are made deathmatches.
events.quote: Garth is forced to kill Varena with a Psionic Blast

events.summary: Garth wins the tournament and is whisked away by Kuthuman, who tries to kill him; Garth wounds him and escapes.
events.quote: Garth disagrees and wounds him, escaping.

events.summary: Varena is revived; the Houses are destroyed fighting Zarel; Garth returns and kills Zarel with a dagger, then he and Norreen vanish with Kuthuman.
events.quote: Garth stabs a dagger in Zarel's chest, killing him.

events.summary: Three years later the city is rebuilt, Varena is Grand Master, and Garth and Norreen return having defeated Kuthuman and sealed his portal.
events.quote: Norreen and Garth return, having defeated Planeswalker Kuthuman and sealed the portal he used so he could not return.

relations.quote: Garth stabs a dagger in Zarel's chest, killing him.

relations.note: Forced to kill her with a Psionic Blast; she is later revived.
relations.quote: Garth is forced to kill Varena with a Psionic Blast

relations.note: They embrace and later raise a child together.
relations.quote: then retire to the countryside to raise their child

relations.note: Used to serve Garth's father, leader of the Fifth House.
relations.quote: used to serve Garth's father, who was the leader of the House

relations.note: Kuthuman killed his family; Garth defeats him.
Grand Master who arranges the games with the Planeswalker.
relations.quote: Grand Master Zarel and Planeswalker Kuthuman arrange for all the final battles of the Games to be deathmatches
